newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-POLLOCK RESTRICTS AUSTRALIA TO 211-9.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-POLLOCK RESTRICTS AUSTRALIA TO 211-9.

text.p: Fast bowler Shaun Pollock took four for 33 as South Africa restricted Australia to 211 for nine in the fourth one-day international on Saturday.
Although opener Greg Blewett made 53 and Adam Gilchrist 77, Australia were always under considerable pressure from accurate South African bowling backed up by some superb fielding.
Without the injured Mark Waugh and out-of-form captain Mark Taylor, the Australian batting appeared a little vulnerable as wickets fell at early and then regular intervals.
The cheap dismissal of the dependable Steve Waugh for only one -- caught by Derek Crookes off Allan Donald at square leg -- was crucial to South Africa's hopes of restricting Australia to below 200.
But Gilchrist, in only his fifth limited overs international, was able to shepherd much-needed resistance from the lower order with his confident score from just 88 balls.
He struck five fours and two sixes and added 42 with Andy Bichel for the eighth wicket before on-driving Pollock to South African captain Hansie Cronje at mid-wicket.
South Africa lead 2-1 in the seven-match series.
